name: Ballista
entries: A massive crossbow that fires weighted bolts. A ship-mounted ballista can be loaded and aimed by the crew using the {@action Operate Ship Weapon|NorthlandsWorldbook} action.
Range: 120/480 ft. {@damage 3d10 + #$prompt_number:min=1,title=Strength/Dexterity modifier,default=123$#|3d10 + ship's Strength/Dexterity modifier} Piercing damage.

name: Naval Ram
entries: This metal and wood ram is mounted to the front of the ship at or below the water level. It can be used to smash a hole in the side of another vessel. If the ship moves more than 30 feet first, a ram deals an additional {@damage 1d10} Piercing damage.
{@damage 2d10 + #$prompt_number:min=1,title=Strength/Dexterity modifier,efault=123$#|3d10 + ship's Strength/Dexterity modifier} Piercing damage.

name: Ship Catapult
entries: A small ship-mounted catapult used to throw stones at enemy vessels. Loading and aiming a ship catapult requires a {@action Utilize|XPHB} action, and firing it uses another. Multiple crew can operate the same siege weapon to perform these actions in the same round.
Range: 200/800 ft. {@damage 3d10 + #$prompt_number:min=1,title=Strength/Dexterity modifier,efault=123$#|3d10 + ship's Strength/Dexterity modifier} Bludgeoning damage.
